source_delta.finding: v6 delegated the durable Agency/wake transition to V4 before optional specialist/GWT cognition; an exception in that later cognition path could therefore leave a committed V4 tick without any v6 causal closure receipt
source_delta.change: v6 now catches cognition-path exceptions only after the V4 commit boundary, persists a sanitized FAILED receipt bound to tick_id, agency_epoch_after, control_epoch and control_snapshot_digest, records provider call count as UNKNOWN_AFTER_EXCEPTION, forbids same-tick retry authorization, then raises CognitiveCycleExecutionError chained from the original exception

regression_added.name: test_post_v4_commit_inference_exception_gets_sanitized_failure_closure
asserts: Agency state advances exactly once at the pre-existing V4 commit boundary
closure is typed FAILED and bound to the committed Agency epoch
provider call count remains unknown after exception instead of being fabricated
raw exception text is absent from the persisted receipt

scientific_frame.hypothesis: post-commit candidate-cognition failure must remain causally observable even when the larger runtime is not yet two-phase atomic
scientific_frame.counterhypothesis: re-raising the cognition exception alone is sufficient because the caller can infer failure from control flow
scientific_frame.decision: reject the counterhypothesis for durable recovery: caller control flow does not survive process death/restart and cannot reconstruct the exact committed Agency/control boundary without a repository-defined durable closure

remaining_gap: The V4 Agency commit and v6 candidate-cognition closure are still separate transactions; a process kill between them can still produce an unclosed committed tick. Full repair requires a separately designed prepare/commit or recovery-reconciliation protocol and admitted runtime evidence.
